# glpi_user (Data Source)

Look up a GLPI user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_user" "by_name" {
  name = "jdoe"
}

data "glpi_user" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Login name. Set id or name; must match exactly one item.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the user can log in.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `firstname` (String) First name.
- `realname` (String) Last name.
